newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN CENTRAL BANK SAYS INJECTING FUNDS AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN CENTRAL BANK SAYS INJECTING FUNDS AGAIN.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank, responding to soaring short-term interest rates, said it would launch further fund injections into the banking system through open market operations on Friday afternoon.
It was the second fund injection by the central bank in one day. In the morning, the central bank injected T$9 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations.
A central bank official said the bank would execute open market operations in the afternoon through repurchase of negotiable certificates of deposit offered by interested financial institutions.
The institutions have the option to repurchase the NCDs within 10 days, the official said.
The central bank said interested financial institutions should contact the bank directly.
Bids would close at 1430 p.m. (0630 GMT).
Funds would be released according to actual demand, the central bank said.
